name: pull-and-share
task: Build a URL shortener HTTP API. master-a owns storage and IDs, master-b joins later and owns the HTTP API.

topics.storage: where and how links are stored
topics.ids: short code format and how IDs are generated

steps.text: I'm taking storage. We'll use SQLite for the MVP: one file and no server to run.
Open question for whoever owns the API: which status code should redirects use?
Starting on the HTTP API. POST /links creates a short link and returns it as JSON.

share.text: Redirects return 302, not 301, so links can be edited later.
Short codes are 7 characters of base62.
Change of plan: short codes are 8 characters of base62, to leave room for growth.
